newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hang Seng Index up over 150 pts ahead close.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hang Seng Index up over 150 pts ahead close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks pushed ahead in Friday afternoon trade, with the Hang Seng Index up 151 points, or 1.23 percent, at 12,510 ahead of the close, led by gains in the banking sector.
Brokers said investors were encouraged by this week's market tone and were betting that stocks had hit a short-term bottom.
As of Thursday's close the Hang Seng Index had gained 154.11 points this week.
"I think this week's performance is a little bit better than expected. There was some weakness on Wall Street but the market seems to be much more resilient," said one analyst.
The Dow industrials fell 23.79 points to 6,540.05 overnight.
